title: Circular Economy Companies Directory
demand_signal: Growing market: $517.79B (2025) → $798.3B (2029). Major brands (Unilever, IKEA, Nike) publicly committing to circular goals. The Global Circular Economy Innovation Database exists but is research-focused, not buyer/investor-friendly. SAP, Landbell Group, and others provide enterprise solutions, but no consumer/SMB directory.
target_audience: Sustainability officers at mid-large companies seeking vendors, impact investors screening portfolio companies, procurement teams with ESG mandates, sustainability consultants researching solutions, and B2B buyers with circular economy requirements
public_data_sources: Cradle to Cradle certified products database
Company websites (circular economy messaging, product takeback programs)
StartUs Insights reports on circular economy startups
competitive_landscape: Global Circular Economy Innovation Database (research tool, not buyer-focused), MSCI Circular Economy Indexes (investor tool, not directory), StartUs Insights (trends/reports, not comprehensive directory). No clear leader in consumer/SMB-accessible directory space. Opportunity for first-mover advantage.
monetization_model: Freemium directory: Free basic listings (company name, industry, location, website). Premium vendor profiles ($299-499/year per company) with detailed product info, certifications, case studies, and contact forms. Sponsored placements for featured vendors. Enterprise API access for procurement platforms.
estimated_market_size: 10K+ companies globally with significant circular economy programs. 100K+ sustainability officers and procurement professionals. TAM: $5-10M annually from premium listings + $2-3M from enterprise access.
data_freshness_requirement: Quarterly updates for company listings. Annual deep refresh of certifications and reports. News monitoring for major announcements (new partnerships, certifications, product launches).
compliance_notes: PASS potential: All data from public corporate disclosures, certification bodies, and news. No proprietary/internal data. No PII. Companies publicly promote circular credentials for marketing/sales purposes. Include source URLs for all claims (certifications, commitments).
next_steps: Curate initial dataset: 200-300 verified circular economy companies
Define taxonomy (product categories, circular model types: repair/reuse/recycle/regenerative)
Build simple directory site with search/filter
Reach out to 10-20 companies to test premium listing interest
Partner with 1-2 sustainability newsletters for initial distribution
researcher_notes: Moderate signal. Market is growing but still early/niche. Key risk: Will buyers actually PAY for this, or just Google it? Mitigation: Focus on vetting/curation as value-add (verified certifications, quality scoring). Consider vertical focus (circular economy for FASHION or ELECTRONICS) to increase relevance. Two-sided marketplace potential if we can drive buyer traffic.
